basic_profile.bio: Hi there! I'm an avid gamer who recently fell in love with Animal Crossing: New Horizons. Originally from Ontario, Canada, I spend my evenings and weekends exploring new virtual worlds. By day, I'm a junior graphic designer at a small advertising firm, which gives me a keen eye for detail and creativity. I enjoy sharing my gaming experiences and occasionally dabble in cooking and DIY projects. I'm single and love connecting with people who share my interests. Typically, I'm online in the late evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've been a gamer since my teenage years, mostly learning through trial and error and community forums. While I don't have formal education in gaming, my job as a graphic designer helps me appreciate the artistic aspects of games. I often turn to Reddit and YouTube tutorials to improve my skills.
